snippets.title: Sign requests with a TAP identity prover (agent)
snippets.note: Follows the mppx source and CHANGELOG at 9405660 (0.19.0, MIT). Since 0.19.0 the prover takes a key pair (or a remote Signer) and rejects a private key alone; the mpp.dev page, read 2026-11-14, still shows the earlier private-key form. Intent payment maps to the tag agent-payer-auth and browse to agent-browser-auth; the prover signs only requests to the origins in scope and uses an 8-minute lifetime by default. Before 0.16.0 this was Mppx.create({ attestation: { tap: Tap.Client.signer(...) } }) from mppx/attestation/tap. Visa publishes no TAP SDK of its own; the visa/trusted-agent-protocol sample is under Visa's Product Terms and is not reproduced here.

snippets.title: Require a TAP signature on a paid route (server)
snippets.note: From the MPP identity docs at d062df6, unchanged for the server in 0.19.0. The verifier runs before any payment Challenge and checks signature, authority and path, lifetime, tag and nonce; since 0.18.0 a missing or invalid signature gets 401 and an untrusted or unresolvable key 403. Resolve keyId only from agent providers you trust. Store.memory() fits a single process only: use a shared atomic store across instances, and since 0.18.0 tempo.charge() throws at construction in production on multi-instance platforms or Cloudflare Workers unless you pass a store.
